title: Validation, sensitivity and competing answers
rows: Quantity, units, interval, initial value, model and inputs.
\(A(T)=\int_0^T q(t)\,dt\); check \(A(0)=0\) and \(A\prime(T)=q(T)\) for continuous q. Stored amount = initial amount + net accumulation.
\(\Delta F=F(p+\delta p)-F(p)\approx F\prime(p)\delta p\). Small admissible changes; check accuracy over the chosen interval.
\(q(t)=a-bt^2\); \(A(T)=aT-bT^3/3\). Fixed T: \(\Delta A=T\delta a-T^3\delta b/3\). Check domain, rate sign and capacity.
Find extrema over allowed inputs; monotonicity can locate endpoint/corner values. Bounds are not probabilities.
Residual = left side − right side. Small residual need not mean small solution error in a sensitive system.
\(|u-v|\leq\max(\varepsilon_{\rm abs},\varepsilon_{\rm rel}\max(|u|,|v|))\). Absolute tolerance has output units; relative tolerance is dimensionless.
For \(q=a-bt^2\) on [0,T], n equal panels: \(Q_n-A(T)=-bT^3/(6n^2)\). Exact arithmetic; fixed model/inputs.
Constant/shifted-linear benchmarks; reversed/zero interval; known curved case; domain and samples; fresh run.
Separate model, input, approximation, implementation and rounding. Vary one factor; retain precision until display.
Question → model/domain → method → independent checks → discrepancy/tolerance → limitations. State assistance used.

# Values expressed in the same units:
isclose(u, v, rel_tol=0.001, abs_tol=0.0005)
# Signed/absolute discrepancy:

error = abs(difference)
# Sensitivity with other inputs fixed:
